name: Rat in a Maze
description: Finds all paths for a rat to travel from the top-left to bottom-right of a maze using backtracking.
aim: Navigate an n×n binary maze (1=open, 0=blocked) by trying all 4 directions recursively and backtracking on dead ends.
howItWorks: Backtrack: unmark cell, try next direction

time.worstCase: Highly connected maze needing full exploration

whenToUse: Find all paths in a maze

inputHint: A grid of 1 (open) and 0 (blocked); rows separated by "/".
